supervisor.value: You apply directly to a thesis subject and the thesis director must validate your application.

funding.value: Doctoral contracts are awarded by a competitive process at UGA.

entry_route.value: You need a national master's degree with a mention or an equivalent diploma.

notes: Covers the school's life-science specialities (cell biology, physiology and pharmacology, virology, neurobiology) as well as chemistry. Foreign or professional master's files go to the equivalence commission (CD3).
